annotations.title: Create a show: a recurring video from a feed

description: [Free] A show makes a video from each new item in a feed: a weekly release video from a changelog, a daily listing video from an RSS feed, a clip per new post. Episodes are ordinary videos made by run_show or, once confirmed, by the scheduler at the show's cadence. A new show is HELD: nothing renders until its owner has called run_show once with confirm=true, and it never spends more than max_credits_per_day.

cadence.description: How often the scheduler runs the show once it is confirmed. manual: only when run_show is called. Default daily; manual for manual and webhook feeds.

feed_kind.description: rss: RSS/Atom. json: a JSON Feed or any JSON API via feed_map. query: one call per run on a registered connection (`source`). watchlist: the fixed items in `watchlist`. webhook: another system POSTs items to the show's webhook URL, signed with the secret returned once (X-PageToVid-Signature: sha256=HMAC of the body); cadence manual. manual: items passed to run_show, never scheduled.

feed_map.description: For feed_kind json when the document is not a JSON Feed: dotted paths, e.g. {"items":"data.results","id":"slug","title":"name","summary":"excerpt","link":"href","image":"cover.url","date":"published_at"}. `items` may be omitted when the document is an array.

feed_url.description: The feed's public URL for rss and json. It is read once now to make sure it parses.

focus_template.description: As create_format. Omitted: a brief leading with the item's title and summary.

format_id.description: Run an existing format (create_format / list_formats) instead of the fields below; its kind must match. Without it, the fields below become the show's own format, version 1, editable later with update_format.

format_version.description: With format_id: pin the show to this version. Omitted, the show follows the format's latest version.

kind.description: video: each episode films the item's own page (like create_video) with focus_template as its brief. animation: each episode is drawn from `scenes` (like create_animation) with the item's data filled in.

max_credits_per_day.description: The show never spends more than this in a UTC day, however many items the feed gains. An episode is 40 credits.

max_episodes_per_run.description: Newest items first; at most this many episodes per run.

name.description: The show's name, e.g. "Le mot du chantier". Available as {{show}} in templates.

repeat_every.description: query and watchlist shows: make every item again each period (the period is in the episode key and available to a programme as {{ item.period }}). none: each item once, ever.

scenes.description: As create_format. An image scene whose {{image}} is empty for an item is dropped from that episode.

site_url.description: Any public http(s) URL on the site; the site is identified by its domain.

source.description: feed_kind query: {call: {mcp: alias, tool, input} | {http: url, query}, select: an expression into the answer that yields the list, map: dotted paths from an element to the item ({id, title, summary, link, image, date})}. Strings in the input may carry {{ show }}, {{ site }} and {{ now }}. Called once now to make sure it answers.

watchlist.description: feed_kind watchlist: the items, as run_show takes them. Each is made once — or once per period with repeat_every.

name: create_show

recent_episodes.description: The five latest: episode_id, item_key, title, item_url, video_id, status, video_status, error, credits, format_version, provenance, created_at.

title: Create a show: a recurring video from a feed
